name: Rainbow Umbrella Youth Group
description: Weekly youth peer group providing check-ins, discussions, and creative workshops supporting mental health, authentic self-expression, and community connection.

name: Little Unicorns
frequency: Last Saturday of the Month, 1:00 PM – 3:00 PM
location: DCVC Community Resource Center / Hobart Park
description: A fun, relaxed peer group for younger LGBTQ+, questioning, and ally kids to make friends, engage in arts, and feel unconditionally affirmed.

name: Queer Adulting Group
frequency: 1st & 3rd Wednesday of the Month, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM
description: An all-inclusive LGBTQAI+ meeting for adults 18+ to socialize, discuss career, relationships, identity, life milestones, and navigate adulting together.

name: Trans Peer Group by The Transverse
description: A relaxed, open-format social and support group for anyone under the transgender, non-binary, and gender non-conforming umbrellas to connect and share stories.

name: Silver Collective
frequency: 2nd Thursday of the Month, 6:00 PM – 7:30 PM
description: Creating welcoming spaces for LGBTQ+ adults 55+ to connect, reminisce, learn, and feel celebrated. Dedicated to visibility and care for older LGBTQ+ adults.

name: Diversity Toastmasters
frequency: 1st & 3rd Tuesday of the Month, 6:30 PM – 8:00 PM
description: LGBTQ+ friendly club to practice public speaking, presentation skills, and leadership development. A safe space to practice telling our true stories without judgment.

name: PFLAG Ventura Chapter
description: The nation's largest organization dedicated to supporting, educating, and advocating for LGBTQ+ people and their families. Monthly meetings in Ventura.

name: Narcotics Anonymous (LGBTQ+ Affirming)
description: Weekly 12-step recovery meeting welcoming all individuals seeking freedom from active addiction in a non-judgmental, inclusive setting.
